links.comparator_used: Default ChatGPT-4o responses to the same questions without prompting for reading level (baseline), plus a separate rephrasing condition
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Grade Level and Flesch Reading Ease) on a post hoc analysis of select questions
links.effect: Median FKRGL 15.6 (IQR 14.4-16.7) at baseline, decreasing to 7.1 (IQR 6.1-8.3) with prompting and 14.5 (IQR 13.2-15.4) with rephrasing; median FRE 18.1 (IQR 14.6-24.7) at baseline, increasing to 73.8 (IQR 66.6-79.3) with prompting and 32.0 (IQR 27.0-37.7) with rephrasing
links.quote: On a post hoc analysis for select questions, the median FKRGL was 15.6 (IQR 14.4-16.7), decreasing to 7.1 (IQR 6.1-8.3) and 14.5 (IQR 13.2-15.4) with prompting and rephrasing, and the median FRE was 18.1 (IQR 14.6-24.7), increasing to 73.8 (IQR 66.6-79.3) and 32.0 (IQR 27.0-37.7) with prompting and rephrasing.
